observations.r828: With optional 16 outstanding snapshot bound, 425 input packets decoded. Last-input messageAck=510, nearest sent sequence=511 (gap 1). This does not establish improved response time relative to active r827; it only bounds sends after acknowledgements stop.
observations.r829: The server queued 116 scoreboard b replies, all 116 were acknowledged, and 394 input packets decoded. Screenshot evidence/experiments/20261030-r829-scoreboard-tab.png, taken while Tab was held, does not show a scoreboard panel.
observations.r830: After two-second unchanged-board throttle, the server queued 19 scoreboard b replies, reached reliable ACK 20 including vision command, and decoded 304 input packets. Last-input messageAck=329, nearest sent sequence=330 (gap 1).

limits: Each run is one independent connection. Vision path was also active in r826-r830, but no three-run set of direct CS2557 memory reads is included in this publication audit; do not call it a completed stable feature on this evidence alone.
Reliable ACK proves command transport, not cgame scoreboard rendering. The Tab UI remains unverified/visually absent in r829.
The server still repeats a static player-state snapshot with clip 30. Native shooting action/sound and user-observed 30-to-22-to-30 bounce do not prove authoritative ammo, hits, or damage.
ESC loadout remained empty in the user-observed match. No loadout or full match acceptance is claimed.
All runs used the existing r107flow runtime. This evidence file omits private game data, certificates, account files, packet bodies, and full logs.
